title: Mystic Sorceress and Cosmic Tree
description: A woman in flowing colorful robes stands in a glowing cosmic pool, arms outstretched as swirling rainbow energy and butterflies emanate from her. Behind her rises a large ethereal white tree with crystal branches and hanging open books, set against a starry night sky with aurora borealis, while ghostly figures on horseback and deer appear in the misty background.
prompt: A mystical woman with dark hair wearing flowing multicolored robes stands in a swirling cosmic pool at the base of a giant ethereal white tree with crystal branches. She has her arms outstretched as rainbow energy swirls around her and glowing butterflies emerge. Open magical books float from the tree's branches against a starry night sky filled with vibrant aurora borealis. Ghostly figures on horseback and deer appear in the purple mist to the right, highly detailed fantasy illustration in a dreamy whimsical style
